# Generated by ppc worldbuilder: vanilla file patched so fleets sent over the open sea never target a river channel; do not edit by hand.
treasure_fleet_expedition = {

	unique = yes
	repeatable = yes
	returns_home = yes
	travel_speed = 1
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	category = diplomatic
	icon = category_diplomatic
	travel_mode = sea
	show_end_message = no

	potential = {
		has_variable = enabled_treasure_voyages
		has_variable = chinese_treasure_voyage_setup
	}

	can_start = {
		has_non_rural_port = yes
		gold >= 200
		at_war = no
		NOT = { has_cooldown = treasure_fleet_cooldown }
	}

	leader = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_alive = yes
		is_ruler = no
		is_female = no
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		add_cooldown = {
			type = treasure_fleet_cooldown
			years = 5
		}
		remove_variable = chinese_treasure_voyage_setup
		set_global_variable = {
			name = chinese_treasure_voyage_running
			value = root
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			pause_expedition = 14
		}
		make_into_expedition_leader = { target = scope:expedition.expedition_leader }

		ordered_owned_non_rural_location = {
			limit = { is_port = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes }
			order_by = development
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = departure_port
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = chinese_treasure_start_location
			value = scope:departure_port
		}
		scope:expedition = { add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_port }

		var:chinese_treasure_target_area = {
			random_location_in_area = {
				limit = { is_coastal = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes }
				save_scope_as = treasure_destination
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = chinese_treasure_target_location
			value = scope:treasure_destination
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = chinese_treasure_leg_progress
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = chinese_treasure_route_tiles
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = chinese_treasure_tiles_traveled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = chinese_treasure_extraditions_accepted value = 0 }

		create_route = {
			start = scope:departure_port
			end = scope:treasure_destination
			limit = { is_land = no NOT = { region = region:pp_navigation_region } }
			weight = {
				value = scope:distance
				if = {
					limit = { is_coastal = yes }
					multiply = 0.75
				}
			}
			movement_cost = yes
			effect = {
				scope:expedition = { add_new_waypoint = PREV }
				scope:expedition.expedition_owner = {
					change_variable = { name = chinese_treasure_route_tiles add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}

		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.3 days = 7 }
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = { discover_location = root }

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { expedition_is_returning = yes } }
				scope:location = var:chinese_treasure_target_location
			}
			set_variable = { name = chinese_treasure_tiles_traveled value = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { expedition_is_returning = yes } }
				NOT = { has_variable = chinese_treasure_low_funds_notified }
				has_variable = chinese_treasure_voyage_cargo
				var:chinese_treasure_voyage_cargo <= 0
			}
			set_variable = chinese_treasure_low_funds_notified
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.22 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = chinese_treasure_voyage_cargo
					var:chinese_treasure_voyage_cargo > 0
					scope:location = {
						any_neighbor_location = { is_port_valid_for_stay = yes }
					}
				}
				scope:location = {
					random_neighbor_location = {
						limit = { is_port_valid_for_stay = yes }
						weight = {
							factor = 1
							modifier = {
								add = { value = development multiply = development }
							}
						}
						save_scope_as = chinese_treasure_visited_port
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = chinese_treasure_visited_port_location
					value = scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port
				}
				scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port = { discover_location = root }
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = visited_ports
					target = scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable_list = visited_countries }
							NOT = {
								is_target_in_variable_list = {
									name = visited_countries
									target = scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port.owner
								}
							}
						}
					}
					add_to_variable_list = {
						name = visited_countries
						target = scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port.owner
					}
				}
				scope:expedition = { pause_expedition = 105 }
				scope:chinese_treasure_visited_port.owner ?= {
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.5 }
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.4 days = 1 }
			}
		}

		update_chinese_treasure_leg_progress = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		scope:expedition = { save_scope_as = target_expedition }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = { expedition_is_traveling = yes }
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { expedition_is_paused = yes } }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 30
				random_list = {
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.23 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.24 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.25 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.26 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.27 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.28 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.29 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = { expedition_is_paused = yes }
				has_variable = chinese_treasure_visited_port_location
			}
			random = {
				chance = 35
				random_list = {
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.30 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.31 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.32 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.33 } }
					50 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.34 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		scope:expedition = {
			expedition_leader ?= {
				remove_character_modifier = chi_leading_expedition
			}
		}
		set_chinese_expedition_scopes = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = treasure_fleet_events.9 }
	}

	on_fail = {
		scope:expedition = {
			expedition_leader ?= {
				remove_character_modifier = chi_leading_expedition
			}
		}
		cleanup_chinese_treasure_voyage_state = yes
	}

	ai_chance_to_check = {
		value = define:NAI|EXPEDITION_DEFAULT_CHANCE_TO_CHECK
		multiply = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler = yes
				ruler = { 
					OR = {
						has_trait = kind_hearted 
						has_trait = benevolent
						has_trait = silver_tongue
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}
